title: Canonical models
description: CANONICAL_MODELS.md. Referenced by the event payload schemas that carry a whole model rather than a flat field list (LISTING_DISCOVERED, ACCOUNT_ALLOCATION_RESPONSE, PURCHASE_COMPLETED, PURCHASE_FAILED). Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (mrp >= price, fully_satisfied consistency, success/field coupling) are enforced by the producing service per VALIDATION_RULES.md §1, §4, §5 — not weakened here, just not expressible.

CanonicalProduct.description: CANONICAL_MODELS.md §CanonicalProduct. Field-level rules from VALIDATION_RULES.md §1 are applied here where JSON Schema can express them.

attributes.description: Open map. `size`/`color`/`variant` are the three keys the Deal Engine reads; any other key is carried through opaquely and not interpreted downstream.

external_listing_id.description: ASIN/FSN/SKU. Unique per marketplace (dedup key) — uniqueness is a database constraint, not a schema one.

url.description: Host must match the marketplace's known domain(s), checked by the connector's validator (VALIDATION_RULES.md §1).

mrp.description: nullable; if present must be >= price (VALIDATION_RULES.md §1, cross-field).

in_stock.description: Connectors must not omit; infer false if the response gives no positive stock signal, never leave null.

ScoreBreakdown.description: CANONICAL_MODELS.md §ScoredDeal.score_breakdown. Stored verbatim and never recomputed — it is the audit trail for why a deal was surfaced, and an ML training feature.

weights_version.description: Which scoring config version produced this.

AllocationPlan.description: CANONICAL_MODELS.md §AllocationPlan. An empty `allocations` array with fully_satisfied=false is a valid response and drives PLANNING_FAILED.

fully_satisfied.description: true if sum(allocations.quantity) == requested_quantity. Order Planner trusts this flag as-is and does not recompute it (VALIDATION_RULES.md §5).

PurchaseOutcome.description: CANONICAL_MODELS.md §PurchaseOutcome. `marketplace_order_ref`/`actual_price_paid` are set only when success=true, `error_code` only when success=false — a coupling enforced by the Purchase Agent, since expressing it here would mean two variant schemas for one documented model.

listing_id.description: Echoed from PURCHASE_TASK_CREATED, needed by Inventory Service's recordAcquisition which has no other source for it.

error_code.description: One of ERROR_CODES.md, set only when success=false.
